prompts.crop-wheat: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a clean single-object image-to-3D reference for a premium children's toy farm. One compact reusable clump of ripe wheat, FIVE short sturdy stalks with large plump golden wheat ears made of sculpted rounded grains, a few broad matte sage-green leaves tying the lower stems together. Warm honey-gold and pale straw, natural green stems, gentle variation, charming handcrafted miniature, refined smooth 3D clay shapes and crisp material colors. The wheat must be recognizably wheat, not corn. Single small clump, silhouette readable from above, overall height about 1.3 times its width, base roots end together at the same floor height. Three-quarter front view at 25 degree downward angle, object centered and fully visible with generous margins. Even neutral studio lighting, minimal contact shadow. Pure clean white background. No ground slab, soil island, pot, basket, stand, plate, fence, tools, grass lawn, text, border, logos or extra objects. Fully three-dimensional thick leaves and robust stems, no hairlike fibers, no transparent planes. Match a beautiful rounded toy farm game, polished and simple, not photorealistic.
prompts.crop-cabbage: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a clean single-object image-to-3D reference for a premium children's toy farm. Thick smoothly sculpted curled leaf edges, restrained shallow vein details, softly asymmetric silhouette with a small stem/root beneath. Refined handcrafted 3D clay miniature, rich natural greens without neon, matte tactile finish. Low wide form, about 0.7 times as tall as wide, clearly a cabbage rather than a rose. Three-quarter front view at 30 degree downward angle, entire cabbage centered with generous margins, neutral even studio illumination and minimal contact shadow. Pure clean white background. No ground slab, soil island, pot, basket, plate, stand, vegetable box, grass lawn, text, frame, logos, extra cabbages or extra objects. Fully three-dimensional thick leaves, no paper thin transparent planes. Polished rounded toy farm game style, simple and beautiful, not photorealistic.
